status: C1 DRAFT. Lives in dreamland_tools until Phase C moves it to dreamland_world/fight/mob_forms.json.
source: Sheet 12gaR7a3 (docs/plans/mob-reform-sheet/*.tsv) with every docs/plans/mob-reform.md §3.2/§3.3/§3.3a correction and §8 decisions 1-50 applied. Resolution order is documented in scripts/body-resolve.py.

groups.upper: upper body, stacks on a lower body, several allowed
groups.full: whole body, excludes lower and upper forms except the ones it implies

renames._note: migration-time renames for the data pass, applied by the resolver as compat. bird is not one: the name belongs to the new full form, so the data pass picks winged or bird by content

deleted_forms.edible: replaced by the derived helper isEdible (rules.edible), decision 24
deleted_forms.intangible: replaced by instant_decay. Fire elemental race gets mist instead (decision 28)
deleted_forms.cold_blood: now a PART (decision 29). Forms grant it through parts_add

magical.notes: may cast and speak without sentient (cast gate is Phase A caster.cpp). Battlerager group rule is a separate ticket

instant_decay.notes: no corpse, no parts, items drop. Absorbs the deleted intangible

sentient.notes: random/recipe drops, speech, casting, global quests. Unlocks sentient_wearlocs of every part and the sheath slot. canHoldCards = sentient AND hands (decision 27)

skeletal.notes: look shows '(skeleton <race>)'. act undead no longer implies necromancer casting (decision 23). Zombies/ghouls are NOT skeletal: act undead + biped + mammal torso. No eyes does not blind it (see parts.eye)

construct.notes: no blood, no animate, no emotions, material drives vulns. parts_del_late runs AFTER the torso ALWAYS-adds (decision 33). isObject should read this form

hoofed.notes: Applied to the LOWER body, before the torso ALWAYS-adds, so a centaur keeps the torso's fingers (§3.3a). Needs a biped or quadruped lower body, else it grants nothing (resolver warns). Rear kick = four_hooves skill gate

mist.notes: +50% web break, stays bloodless. parts_del_late runs after the torso adds (decision 33) on NPC bodies ONLY (decision 48): PC cloud giants keep heart/brains/guts/ear

amphibian.notes: not MVP, IN (decision 18). Desert drying = follow-up ticket. Movetype slink/swim comes from the parts (fins -> swim)

reptile.notes: decision 43 / item 49: the reptile FORM grants regeneration, so every dragon and snake gains it (lizard already had it on the race). The race PR prints that

biped.notes: lower body owns feet, no sentience gate (decision 25)

quadruped.notes: act rideable is NOT a flat add: rules.rideable (decision 26). legs map to wrist_l/wrist_r (parts.legs.quadruped_wearlocs). Engine gives riding only for hooves

insect.notes: walk mechanics (has legs), crawling verb (decision 30). wings imply flying, so the flying verb wins while airborne

mammal.notes: = human torso. eye added (§3.2 correction). ALWAYS-adds win over every lower/full/upper DEL before them. 6 'warm animal' Fenia readers are repointed in Phase D

crustacean.notes: not MVP, IN. OFF_PINCERS is a Fenia innate attack reading the part (decision 31)

bird.notes: new full form on a freed letter. eye and tail added (§3.2 correction). Flying from parts.wings

dragon.notes: kept as a real form (3 code readers), composed of quadruped+reptile+winged. The sheet's flat ACT_RIDEABLE is left to rules.rideable (quadruped and size >= large). Flying from parts.wings

legs.notes: a quadruped's forelegs take wrist_l/wrist_r INSTEAD of the legs slot (§3.3a)

fingers.notes: decision 41: quadrupeds keep the fingers PART (slice, claws), the ring slots only on bodies that also have hands

eye.notes: sheet also lists AFF_BLIND when absent. Not applied: the sheet's own skeletal row says 'cannot be blinded (no eyes)', and no eyeless race today carries blind. Forms that want blind say so (worm)

four_hooves.notes: rear kick, double kick, movetype riding

claws.notes: only leather/cloth gloves (follow-up material rule). Innate attack in Fenia (decision 31)

horns.notes: only leather/cloth helm (follow-up). Innate attack in Fenia

tusks.notes: no mask (follow-up). Innate attack in Fenia

cold_blood.notes: part since decision 29. Gives NO regeneration (decision 43): regeneration comes only from a FORM (reptile, worm, blob). isBloodless = no heart and no cold_blood

beak.notes: new part, peck attack in Fenia

pincers.notes: new part, innate attack in Fenia

wearlocs.special_notes: special slots are engine-managed, never listed on a race, so the race-body comparison ignores them. sheath is sentient only

movetype.engine_rules: ExitsMovement::adjustMovetype: ghost or flying -> flying, hooves -> riding, no legs -> slink, AFF_SWIM on no-swim water -> swimming. Mechanics never change
movetype.notes: Text-only rows copy their BASE row's danger and move cost (item 50: galloping and clattering copy riding's MOVETYPE_DANGEROUS, crawling/trotting/hopping copy walk, slithering/oozing copy slink). galloping = hoofed quadruped with NO rider, clattering = hoofed biped with no rider (decision 47), riding when ridden. Otherwise the most specific form verb (priority list), race <moveverb> overrides it, prototype never does (decision 37)

ac.combine: max over the forms that carry ac_factor
ac.notes: matches the plan's listed values (blob 0.86 .. crustacean 1.49, biped 1.0). The plan text's '0.8 + 0.07*(f-3)' formula contradicts its own list and is treated as a typo

rules.rideable: form quadruped AND (form hoofed OR size >= large)
rules.edible: NOT any of construct, skeletal, mist, instant_decay, magical (isEdible, decision 24)
rules.bloodless: no heart AND no cold_blood part, or form skeletal/construct/mist
